scope: Uniform presentation scaling of owned canvases, drawing frames, work areas and image placements

fullNode.note: Before final preview/snapshot protections and final snapshot regression; covered by focused checks.

relatedFocusedNode.note: Overlaps full and final focused checks; do not sum.

invariants: Source CAD geometry, annotations, constraints and frame crop coordinates remain unchanged.
Paper style option either scales or preserves physical text, strokes and dashes cumulatively.
Image assets, hashes, crop, mask, opacity and adjustments remain unchanged.
Review is detached; Apply is one Undo; stale and rejected plans cannot partially publish.
SVG and existing raster PDF use the same scaled frame scene.
limits: Uniform positive scale 0.001 to 1000; resulting bounds, styles and denominator retain their limits.
Direct physical CAD resizing and non-uniform curve/constraint conversion are rejected.
Shared references and excluded images are pinned and reported.
Connected, stitched or sheet-owned frames require their owning tools.
Images use matching model units; drawing frames use matching paper units.
No automatic reflow, unit conversion or new shadow/blur effect model.
